verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly document running Mintlify in your own cloud or on-premises (AWS or any Kubernetes platform) — a real self-host deployment option (mintlify-docs-18). However, community evidence indicates this is a source-available, enterprise-tier capability rather than an open, freely self-hostable core product: one commenter notes 'the license restricts the backend enterprise features to source-available only' and another describes the mainstream product as 'pure SaaS' unsuitable for regulated environments requiring source to stay in-house. Missing for 10: evidence of a fully open-source/self-hostable core (not just enterprise on-prem deployment), independent hands-on confirmation of a successful self-host setup, and clarity on licensing terms for self-hosted use.
